no_adcom_quote.quote: Your application for Baxdela was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because the application did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues that were unexpected for a drug of this class.

summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for the Baxdela (delafloxacin) ABSSSI application (NDA208610). The original 2017 approval letter states the application was not referred to an advisory committee because it did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues unexpected for a fluoroquinolone. No review documents (Summary Review, CDTL, Medical Review) are available in paperclip for this application; only application letters and labels are present, and none references an AdComm meeting.
